atoms.title: String Instruments
atoms.b: String instruments are instruments whose sound is created with strings.
A ((++string_instrument keyboard_instrument)) has one or more ((springs ++strings)).
The strings are strung over the body of the instrument and fastened on both ends.
To play a note, you have to make the strings vibrate.
To do this, you either ((++pluck squeeze)) the strings or use a bow to ((sow ++stroke)) the strings.
atoms.sound: To do this, you either pluck the strings or use a beau to stroke the strings.

atoms.b: Because of the two different styles of playing, we differentiate between bowed string instruments and plucked string instruments.
atoms.sound: Because of the two different styles of playing, we differentiate between beau'd string instruments and plucked string instruments.

example.a: The cello is an example for a bowed string instrument. It is mostly played with a bow, though it is still possible to pluck the strings.
example.sound: The cello is an example for a beau'd string instrument. It is mostly played with a beau though it is still possible to pluck the strings.

example.a: The guitar is a plucked string instrument because it is only very rarely played with a bow and almost always plucked.
example.sound: The guitar is a plucked string instrument, because it is only very rarely played with a beau and almost always plucked.

instruction.text: Find and select all of the string instruments.

atoms.a: How do you play a string instrument?
b: ++by plucking or drawing a bow across the strings
